name: Axteria Group Berhad
overview: Axteria Group Berhad 今年提出以 RM35.0 million 现金收购 Niaga Sari Sdn Bhd 80.0% 股权，该收购属于非关联方交易。公司同时进行多项募资活动（发行新股）。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比上升 44.0%，但净利润同比下降 521.9%。
overview_en: Axteria Group Berhad proposed to acquire an 80.0% equity interest in Niaga Sari Sdn Bhd for a cash consideration of RM35.0 million, a non-related party transaction. The company also carried out several fund-raising exercises via new share issuances. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 44.0% year-on-year while net profit fell 521.9% year-on-year.
